summary: a scenario records a boot's panic or halt only when the console or the registers show it, once a boot, and each end a wait observes

argv: exec ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -O1 -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -I tests/host -I tools/etude/include -I tools/etude -I tools/etude/posix -I tools/etude/guest -I utils tests/host/etude_scenario_hosttest.c ${SRC}/tools/etude/posix/scenario.c tools/etude/posix/case_main.c tools/etude/serial.c tools/etude/processor.c tools/etude/posix/qemu.c tools/etude/qemu_profile.c tools/etude/posix/exec.c tools/etude/posix/keeper.c tools/etude/posix/process.c tools/etude/posix/store.c tools/etude/capture.c tools/etude/history_json.c tools/etude/guest/guest.c tools/etude/guest/fixture.c tools/etude/guest/wire.c utils/sha256.c -o ${WORK}/test

faults.name: panic-unshown
faults.summary: a panic recorded without its record on the console

faults.name: halt-interrupts
faults.summary: a processor taken as halted with interrupts on

faults.name: halt-first-only
faults.summary: the first processor taken for all of them

faults.name: other-end
faults.summary: an end other than a panic or a halt taken as a fault

faults.name: fault-twice
faults.summary: a second fault of a boot accepted

faults.name: fault-unrecorded
faults.summary: a fault shown but not recorded

faults.name: end-unrecorded
faults.summary: the end the launcher observes not recorded

faults.name: end-replaced
faults.summary: a later end recorded after a boot's fault
